result.document_summary: A mid-document fragment of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 5 (Public Safety), covering emergency price-gouging, police cost recovery, incarceration fees and grocery price marking, with no residential rental rule in scope and no text of the algorithmic rent-setting section its URL names.
result.notes: No in-scope rule is stated in this part. Section 51.0204 caps price increases at 10% for goods and services (including 'housing', defined as rental housing on month-to-month or one-year terms) for 30 days after an emergency proclamation. It is an emergency price-gouging rule, not a standing rent cap, so it was not extracted as rent_increase_limits; reviewers may wish to check whether the project wants it recorded. The page URL and metadata refer to a San Diego ordinance on use and sale of algorithmic devices (Division 11, section 98.1103), but the text provided in this part does not contain that ordinance, so nothing was extracted for algorithmic_rent_setting. The remaining sections (police services at large events, incarceration fees, consumer commodity price marking) are out of scope.
